objective: Implement Phase D: Real AI Knowledge Extraction with Gemini API Integration & Evidence Grounding
acceptance_criteria: Google GenAI SDK (@google/genai) integrated through server-side backend API route (/api/analysis/extract)
Server-side environment key validation (GEMINI_API_KEY) with explicit configuration error feedback when missing; zero fake AI substitution
Structured extraction pipeline for 7 categories: Decisions (with reasoning/impact), Pending Tasks, Responsibilities, Risks, Dependencies, Unresolved Questions, and Next Actions

Strict Evidence Grounding: Backend independently verifies every supporting quote against original extracted document text and calculates exact source coordinates (PDF page numbers, TXT/MD line numbers)
Unverified or missing evidence is explicitly marked as UNCERTAIN or MISSING status with explanation; no fabricated citations or owners
Long document chunking and cross-chunk deduplication with context preservation
Human Review Integration: All newly generated findings default to approved: false, rejected: false and feed directly into Human Review Center without bypassing Phase A gates
AI Analysis UI upgraded with Analyse Project trigger, document selection, real progress telemetry, findings grouping, and API key configuration guidance
Data persistence: Extracted findings, citations, and analysis state persist in the workspace via DurableFileRepository

Automated test suite covering API configuration, JSON validation, entity extraction across all 7 categories, quote grounding verification, chunking, deduplication, persistence, and unapproved status defaults
Production build and typecheck pass with zero errors
non_goals: Do not implement advanced cross-document contradiction resolution engine in this phase (Phase E)
Do not alter Google Stitch design tokens or warm sage visual styling
Do not bypass Phase A handover integrity approval gates or Phase B anonymous workspace persistence
Do not add login or signup

verification.result: 46 of 46 automated tests pass across Phase A (Handover Integrity), Phase B (Data Persistence & Workspace Isolation), Phase C (Real Document Ingestion & Extraction), and Phase D (Real AI Knowledge Extraction & Evidence Grounding). Production build compiles cleanly with zero type or webpack errors.
